project_type: Python FastAPI backend for an autonomous AI company OS (NEXUS)
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), fixtures in tests/conftest.py, unittest.mock for mocking
verification_instructions: Run pytest and confirm all tests pass (baseline: 1893 passing). No ruff or mypy failures.
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 is at /usr/bin/python3.12. The default python3 is 3.9, MUST use python3.12 explicitly. OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Do NOT touch dashboard/ directory.
contribution_requirements: All code must have docstrings, type hints, follow ruff (100 char lines, py312 target). Use Python 3.12 features (type unions with |). Every module independently testable. Backward compatibility required.
key_patterns: Adapters inherit from BaseAdapter (src/nexus/adapters/base.py) with _do_* hooks. Protocols are @runtime_checkable. Tests use AsyncMock for subprocess, MagicMock for sync. Test files at tests/test_<module>.py. Embedding providers follow EmbeddingProvider protocol. Config via pydantic-settings in src/nexus/config.py.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is the main package. Adapters in src/nexus/adapters/, tools in src/nexus/tools/, memory in src/nexus/memory/, governance in src/nexus/governance/, knowledge in src/nexus/knowledge/. Tests in tests/ at project root.
